versions.changelog:
- Initial release of jira-ticket-generator skill.
- Generates bilingual (Chinese/English) JIRA ticket descriptions from user input.
- Supports Bug, Task, Story, and Epic issue types with dedicated templates.
- Enforces title formatting with bilingual content and [PREFIX] tag.
- Provides structured description sections: Objective, Requirements, and Acceptance Criteria.
- Includes step-by-step workflow and best practice guidelines for clarity and consistency.
